raw_route_audit.source: RINEX central text fields and raw timing/observable/signal columns only; enriched SvPosition/SvElevation/Wls columns were not read

selection.contract: For Galileo E1 only, select eph.tgd_secondary when the RINEX data-source clock bit 9 identifies I/NAV (E5b-referenced clock), eph.tgd when bit 8 identifies F/NAV (E5a-referenced clock), and preserve eph.tgd when source bits are absent or ambiguous. GPS/QZSS/BeiDou/other signals are unchanged.
selection.why: This is the smallest demonstrable source-level physical mismatch: the parser already retains both Galileo BGD fields and source bits, while the measurement helpers currently discard the source distinction. It is raw/nav-derived, bounded, testable, and avoids the prohibited base compensation.
not_selected: base observation compensation: requires prohibited base assets
new atmospheric/robust thresholds: already sealed lanes or truth-sensitive
Sagnac rewrite: native single-rotation contract is already explicit
Galileo E5a correction: direct single-frequency RTKLIB contract is not established by the pinned source and will not be guessed
